claim_text: A lizard whispering in the president's ear with his full attention, the Secretary of State in the office over the Spanish-speaking, Mexican and Cuban peoples, and two transparent flags moving over the water with Cuba on top and Mexico below, trying to merge.
quote: they were trying to merge together in some way
falsify_match: A formal union or association between Cuba and Mexico.
falsify_miss: None. What the merger would mean is never said, which keeps it from being scoreable.

claim_text: The Mexican president with her back toward Cuba, and he confirms he said she would be removed and replaced by a conservative man who looks like Antonio Banderas, but adds that the Lord made it conditional on the church praying, with a shaking coming in Mexico and things starting with the cartel.
quote: another person will come if the church will pray. It was conditional
falsify_match: The Mexican president leaving office early with a conservative succeeding her.
falsify_miss: She serves her term. He states the conditionality explicitly here, which is rare and worth recording.

claim_text: Out of Cuba they bring guerrilla warfare against the administration and the troops occupying Venezuela and its oil fields, with fighters coming out of Colombia and Brazil and the cartel threatening, aimed at American servicemen and women on the ground in Venezuela.
quote: they will come out of Colombia and they will come out of Brazil
falsify_match: Irregular fighters from those countries attacking American forces in Venezuela.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling of the guerrilla warfare claim.

claim_text: A good leader for Mexico and the same for Cuba with a major revival, and revival for Venezuela, Brazil and Colombia with a major harvest of souls, which he calls the window and the door of opportunity.
quote: this will be the window and the door of opportunity
falsify_match: Church growth across those four countries after a change of government.
falsify_miss: None. He uses window and door together here, where he elsewhere distinguishes them sharply.

claim_text: Revival throughout South Korea, Taiwan and Asia with Japan shaking, and bad laws being passed for persecution of the church in Europe and France concerning free speech, where speaking and decreeing what the Bible says is called hate speech.
quote: Bad laws are trying to be passed for persecution of the church in Europe
falsify_match: French or European legislation criminalising religious speech.
falsify_miss: None passed. European hate speech law predates this by decades, which is the priority problem.

claim_text: Once the foundation is laid it is about the foreign side, because America runs Japan and the Sooners want to jump on too, and as America's banking goes so goes the world, with a great deal of financial corruption in it.
quote: As America's banking goes, so does the world
falsify_match: Other jurisdictions following an American framework.
falsify_miss: They lead instead. The Sooners image is still not attached to a specific action.

claim_text: Europe scrambles as clarity is brought, with Macron, England, France, Italy and Germany all scrambling for their own thing and the EU trying to jump on board.
quote: Europe scrambles for their own thing
falsify_match: A rushed European response to American crypto legislation.
falsify_miss: None. The EU regime was already in force when he said this, which cuts against the scramble.

claim_text: Great blessing coming on Israel and its agriculture, and spiders which the Lord tells him are drones, a new tech boom of spider drones using AI as weapons, transparent with moving bellies, before he breaks off saying he may be saying too much.
quote: They're spider drones. This is a new AI using this for uh weapons
falsify_match: A deployed drone of that form.
falsify_miss: None. He stops himself, saying he thought he was to be still, so the description goes no further.

claim_text: The cartel exposed, asteroids, plots against the nation uncovered, a black cloak trying to hide an agenda, and the Santa Fe Railroad again with box cars and plans involving box cars travelling, with America feeling like September 11th again, praying over the elections and the summer.
quote: I saw Santa Fe Railroad again. I saw uh uh box cars
falsify_match: An attack involving rail freight in America.
falsify_miss: None. The railroad and box cars recur across several tellings without an event attached.

claim_text: With Iran being struck he asks what happens next and answers an escalation of war: plan A is the tariffs and plan B is Iran's oil wells, because the way to back the dollar and bail yourself out is war, with world war three, Venezuela and Cuba, to stimulate the economy, and the petrodollar rising as Iran's refineries burn.
quote: How do you back the dollar? How do you bail yourself out? War
falsify_match: War on Iranian oil following a failure of the tariffs.
falsify_miss: It does not follow. This is the earliest telling of the plan A and plan B structure.

claim_text: A hurricane turning up to a category five, and a black alligator with purple around it identified as a named Supreme Court justice to pray for, influencing decisions concerning Canada, Europe, the dollar and the euro, with darkness pushing the judges politically through finances from a named asset manager.
quote: it was Amy Coney Barrett by I am. And the Lord said, Pray for her
falsify_match: Evidence of outside influence on the tariff ruling.
falsify_miss: None. The ruling itself is a matter of record; the influence is what would have to be shown.

claim_text: The Lord said the Supreme Court decision against the tariff is vital, the lifeblood of the American economy, a do or die rather than a what if, because the tariffs are what allows the economy to flourish and go to the next level.
quote: This is a a do or die. This is very serious
falsify_match: The tariffs upheld and the economy strengthening.
falsify_miss: They are struck down and nothing follows. Do or die is the strongest framing he gives the ruling.

claim_text: The tariffs sustain him in keeping the canoe from going over the waterfall, so plan A is the tariff and plan B is a scramble to salvage the economy if it falls and trillions have to be paid back to other nations.
quote: Plan A is the tariff. Plan B is is I saw trying to scramble
falsify_match: Repayment of collected tariffs after an adverse ruling.
falsify_miss: No repayment. The scenario is specific and turns on a court decision that can be checked.

claim_text: They are thirty four or more than forty trillion dollars in the hole, and with that much debt you have to have a Hail Mary play, which is why the Supreme Court decision on the tariffs matters so much.
quote: We're 34 or more 40 trillion dollars in the hole
falsify_match: A fiscal crisis on that scale.
falsify_miss: None. He gives the figure two ways in one sentence; the published debt was about thirty eight trillion.

claim_text: The black alligator with black onyx eyes and a purple energy outline, with the Canadian prime minister influencing the decisions from Canada over political agenda and funding, Canada's economy going into a great recession into depression, and it reaching into England and the EU and the euro.
quote: I see a alligator. It's a dark black alligator with black onyx eyes
falsify_match: A Canadian recession alongside evidence of pressure on the ruling.
falsify_miss: Neither. He names Canada as mattering more here than any other nation.

claim_text: It has to do with the named asset manager influencing the judges, and he plays a clip saying the court has been swayed by foreign interests with undue influence through fear, respect or friendship.
quote: This has to do with BlackRock influencing the judges
falsify_match: Documented influence by that firm on the case.
falsify_miss: None. He offers a commentator's opinion clip as the support.

claim_text: He slapped another ten per cent on, and political theatre has come just as the Lord said, with a thousand companies now filing lawsuits against the administration for their money after the ruling.
quote: political theater just like the Lord told us was coming
falsify_match: The earlier recordings name the litigation before it began.
falsify_miss: They do not. The thousand companies figure is read from the news.

claim_text: Praying over Iran and the boats, that two named American carriers and all the battleships are covered, because in the spirit he saw the same kind of barrage that came on Israel which the golden dome could not stop, coming against the boats despite the anti-missile systems and the lasers.
quote: the golden dome couldn't stop everything trying to come against our boats
falsify_match: A missile barrage overwhelming defences around an American carrier.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest naming of both carriers, which can be checked against deployment records.

claim_text: Turkey and Syria seen bold with the border all the way around Israel, and a man with a beard in a suit whom he identifies as the leader over Syria, who is angry.
quote: IT'S THE LEADER OVER SYRIA right now
falsify_match: Syria and Turkey moving against Israel together.
falsify_miss: They do not. This is the earliest telling of the pairing, before Egypt is added.

claim_text: He thanks God for grace and says this is about Canada, and looking toward Canada he sees the prime minister.
quote: This is about Canada. And I'm looking toward Canada
falsify_match: Nothing on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing. A name with nothing attached, though it recurs through the Canada material.

claim_text: He sees the Gaza strip again with the very beginning of the ground being broken and buildings going up, hollow metal structures rather than timber framing.
quote: the very beginning of the ground being broken in Gaza
falsify_match: Construction beginning in Gaza.
falsify_miss: None begins. Metal rather than timber framing is the detail that could be checked in any footage.

claim_text: He asks whether this is before the plague, thanks them for helping push back the critters, and says it will make more sense if he is allowed to release the next video with what he is seeing about Israel and how close the second coming is.
quote: maybe if I'm allowed to release this next video
falsify_match: Nothing. He withholds the content.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Another point where the sharpest material stays off the record.

claim_text: Praying that the lizard goes away and leaves him alone and that he has discernment about who he listens to, that Cuba and Mexico are liberated with revival and the people of Iran liberated, and then he sees a massive octopus snake wrapped around Iran like a constrictor pulling tight.
quote: I see a snake wrapped around Iran. It is a massive octopus snake
falsify_match: Nothing observable from the snake itself.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. The liberation claims beside it are what could be scored.

claim_text: The snake is cut in two and Leviathan and the other aquatic demonic things bound, with revival in Iran and North Korea, and the Ayatollah removed, which he says is going to happen, with a bald man coming up beside him and a man with grey hair.
quote: the Ayatollah Khomeini is removed. Yep. It's going to happen
falsify_match: The Iranian supreme leader removed and replaced by the men he describes.
falsify_miss: He remains. He states flatly that it is going to happen, which is stronger than a petition.

claim_text: He says some of what he saw he does not want to make public and some he does, but that he stands by everything he believes the Lord shows him.
quote: I stand by everything I I believe the Lord shows me
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement about his own position.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Recorded because it sits against the material he says he will not release.

claim_text: The demonic will run right over them as seen in New York, with great fires and buildings on the forty first floor, and the gas plants they were told to pray over with the seven people, the seven employees in white helmets, and layers to the explosion.
quote: the seven people, the seven employees with the white helmets
falsify_match: A plant explosion killing about seven workers.
falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling of the seven, and it adds the white helmets.

claim_text: A new type of sexually transmitted disease never seen before coming through practices he calls ungodly, because the scales in the spirit realm were weighed and found lacking, filtering into New York, Boston and the major cities, with judgment beginning even in Japan over the trafficking coming up from Mexico.
quote: a new venerial disease that had never been seen before
falsify_match: A newly identified sexually transmitted infection spreading in those cities.
falsify_miss: None identified. He dates this telling to almost a year earlier, which he is replaying here.

claim_text: They will not bow to social pressure but will proclaim that Jesus is coming, and it is time for the church to rise up with no more compromise, because what you compromise you lose, and America will not be a Muslim nation.
quote: We will not be a nation that is Muslim
falsify_match: Nothing measurable. A declaration.
falsify_miss: Nothing measurable, though it sits against his own Friday worship material.

claim_text: The Supreme Court decision on the tariffs will set the course of the nation for the rest of the term, and it is a named justice they have to sway because she is the problem, whose face is before him strongly in the vision.
quote: it's Amy Comey Barrett is the one that we got to sway
falsify_match: That justice being the deciding vote against the tariffs.
falsify_miss: She votes the other way. This is the earliest telling and names her outright.

claim_text: The Canadian prime minister is influencing these decisions from Canada with a political agenda touching the Democratic Party, and it is more about Canada and its economy going into a great recession into depression, with pressure concerning funding.
quote: It's more about Canada and the economy going into a great recession
falsify_match: A Canadian recession deepening into depression.
falsify_miss: It does not. Depression is a threshold that would be unmistakable.

claim_text: The people of Iran liberated from the Ayatollah with a major revival in the underground church, and in Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iraq, Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, with the temples and the monkey temples shaken by great earthquakes so that what has stood for thousands of years is shaken in a day as a sign of the times.
quote: You shake the monkey temples. You shake them with great earthquakes
falsify_match: Ancient temples destroyed by earthquakes.
falsify_miss: None. Shaken in a day is a threshold that would be unmistakable if met.

claim_text: He tells them to go back over the things he has told them and pray over them, says there are things he will not talk about especially concerning Iran and the president, and asks for prayer over the Supreme Court decision on the tariffs in the next couple of weeks or the next day or so.
quote: in the next couple of weeks or in the next day or so
falsify_match: The ruling coming in that window.
falsify_miss: It comes later. He gives two horizons at once, a day or a couple of weeks.

claim_text: Something in New York not far from where they are, and people emailing about the sexually transmitted infection, which he says is foul with infection all over the face, and he recalls saying he saw a new sexually transmitted virus coming so grotesque it would bring welts and pus.
quote: so grotesque that it would bring welps and and pus
falsify_match: The reported cases confirmed as a new pathogen.
falsify_miss: They are a known infection. He offers viewer emails and photographs as the confirmation.

claim_text: It comes from people messing with children, and the Lord said it will start up in the north east which he believes is Minnesota, going into Toronto and all over, getting much worse and spreading throughout New York.
quote: the Lord said it will start up northeast
falsify_match: An outbreak beginning in the north east and reaching Toronto and New York.
falsify_miss: None. He places Minnesota in the north east, which it is not, and says so in the same breath.

claim_text: Pray for people's safety because the enemy will desire to take people out ahead of time, and 1 Corinthians 5:5 is coming to full manifestation in a greater measure in the church, with the shaking he said was coming to churches in California, a cleaning of the house whose first fruits are already visible.
quote: I told you shaking's coming to church in California
falsify_match: A run of scandals or collapses among Californian churches.
falsify_miss: None. First fruits already visible means partial evidence is claimed in advance.

claim_text: Recalling what he saw, a Jason Bourne type experience with the Ukrainian president snorting cocaine surrounded by prostitutes, with a hundred million in hundred dollar bills on a plane, about to flee.
quote: I saw that he had a hundred million in hundred dollar bills
falsify_match: The Ukrainian president fleeing with cash.
falsify_miss: He does not. The cocaine claim has been made about him for years without evidence.

claim_text: A plan between Russia and America to remove him in a Jason Bourne fashion, after which Russia gets half of Ukraine up to Kyiv and a new pro-Russia government brings peace, because the puppet was being manipulated by the EU and Macron and was looking to Macron with a Pinocchio nose.
quote: I saw Russia get half of Ukraine. All the way up to Kiev
falsify_match: A partition leaving Russia holding territory up to Kyiv.
falsify_miss: A different settlement. Half of Ukraine and the line at Kyiv are the measurable parts.

claim_text: In the visitation he saw a Russian man on his belly dressed all in black, and after he gave that word Russia turned to being friends and bringing the dollar together again, which he points to in an article saying Russia wants to join up with America and the dollar.
quote: Let's bring our dollar together again
falsify_match: A Russian move toward dollar settlement with America.
falsify_miss: None. He treats a same-day article as the confirmation of the word.

claim_text: He asks whether they are abandoning BRICS, notes Cuba and Russia wanting oil agreements, and asks whether it is a smokescreen, because he saw a Tasmanian-looking devil spinning around Putin creating a major war with a new weapon over Warsaw never used before, saying he only has to buy time until the end of this presidency and then he will make his move.
quote: I just have to buy the time to get through your presidency
falsify_match: A Russian move against Europe after January 2029 using a novel weapon.
falsify_miss: None. Buying time until after the presidency pushes the test past 2028.

claim_text: He plays a recorded word from another prophet saying to keep an eye on Russia because a huge deception is taking place that is yet to unveil and that people will even embrace it, with a hand extended out of Russia to Christians and Jews as if it were a friend.
quote: keep their eye on Russia because there's a huge deception
falsify_match: Not his claim. Another man's word that he plays.
falsify_miss: Not his claim, though he adopts it as support for his own.

claim_text: The recorded word continues that Russia is not a friend to the Jews or the Christians, meaning the administration rather than the people, with the extended hand shaken by purple robes and then raised and smashed down on the neck, which he reads as the persecution coming to the church and to the Jews.
quote: I saw the hand raised up and then smashing them on the neck
falsify_match: A Russian betrayal of a religious accommodation.
falsify_miss: None. He supplies the interpretation of another man's image.

claim_text: There is darkness and he feels great caution about this valley of decision, and he says he told them great antisemitism would come because he believes Israel probably acts alone against Iran with America backing them, which is why the Jewish community would uproot and want to move home.
quote: I believe Israel probably act alone against Iran
falsify_match: Israel striking Iran alone with American backing rather than participation.
falsify_miss: America takes part directly. He hedges with probably and maybe here.

claim_text: A sleight of hand by which the legacy media tries to make people watch them again and become the victim, perhaps another September 11th type event or several things, because alternative media channels are exploding with millions of views.
quote: What makes them become the victim?
falsify_match: An event that restores legacy media audiences.
falsify_miss: None. He asks the question rather than answering it, which is where the claim stops.

claim_text: He feels a caution and a major storm on the East Coast, and recalls saying he saw biological weapons taken from Russia to be put into Cuba, asking whether this is the opportunity they are doing it, put underground in the middle of the night, and warns the president to be careful who he trusts and who extends an olive branch.
quote: I saw biological weapons being taken from Russia to put into Cuba
falsify_match: Russian biological or nuclear material found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. This is the earliest telling of the weapon being moved into Cuba.

claim_text: It ran through Europe and the Middle East fast with a black trail glowing behind it, leaving an imprint in the atmosphere that changed things, and as it rode there was drought and pestilence coming that people had no idea about, with many going through much in the days ahead.
quote: it had a black train like glow like trail moving behind him
falsify_match: Drought and epidemic across Europe and the Middle East.
falsify_miss: Neither. The black horse imagery is scriptural, so the reading is supplied rather than seen.
